summary: AAP security depends on the RHEL hosts, which must be hardened per the RHEL 8, 9 or 10 security hardening guides and any required profiles (CIS, DISA STIG, HIPAA) before installing AAP. RHEL 9 or later is recommended and is required for containerized installs; the RPM method is not available on RHEL 10.
questions: Which RHEL version should I use for AAP 2.6?
Can I install AAP with RPMs on RHEL 10?
Should I apply STIG before installing AAP?
